subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain builtin memory status report `Vector store: ready` from persisted `vectorDims` metadata when vector search is enabled, or should `ready` remain reserved for a live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The code change is narrow and proven, but the meaning of CLI/JSON readiness is a compatibility-facing status contract that tests cannot decide for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR with `--deep` remaining the live vector-store probe and plain status reporting prior successful vector indexing from metadata.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Wording Or Signal
options.body: Revise the output or JSON shape so metadata-backed indexed state cannot be confused with current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For Another Canonical Fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers prefer a different status contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR with `--deep` remaining the live vector-store probe and plain status reporting prior successful vector indexing from metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the live PR and has recent memory-core migration/vector-publish history near the affected status path.
